$comment: Sources the explorer backend reads. Paths are relative to core/explorer/. A sources.local.json (gitignored) replaces this file when present. `packets`: the data packets (contract/packet.ts, docs/packet-format.md), each a bundle with a packet.json; build/explorer-sim is the MiSArch packet (pnpm packet:misarch writes its manifest, docs and Verify files, pnpm export:run its runs). `sources`: further bundles ({id, kind: "bundle", path}). Which packet may run which of its commands is set in server.local.json (gitignored), never by a packet.
